// diagnostic

E2420

Unknown analytics column `{column}`

What

Unknown analytics column `{column}`

Why

`{column}` is not a field on the typed query row; DuckDB would fail at runtime, but Jet checks the schema at compile time

Fix

Write one of the fields named by the row type

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2420: tests/ui/analytics_query_unknown_column.stderr.

Error [E2420]: Unknown analytics column `quntity`
  --> tests/ui/analytics_query_unknown_column.jet:10:43
    |
 10 |     query :: csv.query<Sale>("sales.csv", SQL{"SELECT * FROM sales WHERE quntity > 1"})
    |                                           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `quntity` is not a field on `Sale`; the analytics engine would fail at runtime, but Jet checks this schema at compile time
 Fix: Write one of: item, qty
